pdfCompressor.levelLowDesc: Small reduction, best quality. Good for print.
pdfCompressor.levelMediumDesc: Balanced compression. Best for most uses.
pdfCompressor.levelHighDesc: Maximum reduction, slight quality loss. Good for email/web.
pdfCompressor.howToTitle: How to Compress a PDF Online
pdfCompressor.howToStep1: Upload your PDF — Drag and drop your file or click to browse. Maximum file size is 50MB.
pdfCompressor.howToStep2: Choose compression level — Select Low (best quality), Medium (balanced), or High (smallest file size).
pdfCompressor.howToStep3: Download — Click "Compress PDF" and download your smaller file in seconds.
pdfCompressor.whyFree: 100% Free — No hidden costs, no premium plan required.
pdfCompressor.whyNoSignup: No Signup — Start compressing immediately, no account needed.
pdfCompressor.whyFast: Fast Processing — Most files are compressed in under 10 seconds.
pdfCompressor.whySecure: Secure & Private — Your files are automatically deleted after 1 hour.
pdfCompressor.whyQuality: Quality Control — Choose your compression level to balance size and quality.
pdfCompressor.faqFreeA: Yes, ToolFlare PDF Compressor is 100% free to use with no limitations.
pdfCompressor.faqSafeA: Absolutely. All uploaded files are automatically deleted from our servers after 1 hour.
pdfCompressor.faqSizeQ: What is the maximum file size?
pdfCompressor.faqSizeA: You can upload PDF files up to 50MB in size.
pdfCompressor.faqQualityA: It depends on the compression level you choose. "Low" preserves the best quality, while "High" provides maximum size reduction.
pdfCompressor.faqBatchQ: Can I compress multiple PDFs at once?
pdfCompressor.faqBatchA: Batch compression is coming soon. For now, you can compress one PDF at a time.
